review.brief_reason: Under gplearn protected semantics, log(sqrt(x3)) is not always equal to log(x3)/2. For 0.000001 < abs(x3) <= 0.001, sqrt(abs(x3)) exceeds the log threshold while abs(x3) does not, so the original log can be nonzero whereas the proposed log is zero. The surrounding protected square roots do not generally mask this difference.
review.counterexample: At x0=1 and x3=0.0001, log(sqrt(x3))=log(0.01)≈-4.60517, while log(x3)/2=0 because abs(x3)<=0.001. Evaluating the full expressions gives approximately 0.7084 for the original and 0.8736 for the proposed expression.
